create_gemma3_image_processor: create a Gemma3ImageProcessor instance with configurable pan-and-scan parameters for multimodal image preprocessing
run_pan_and_scan_batched: run pan-and-scan batched cropping on torch tensors to split wide or tall images into square crops
preprocess_gemma3_images: preprocess a batch of images through resize, rescale, normalize, and optional pan-and-scan cropping for Gemma3 input
group_images_by_shape: group images by their spatial dimensions to enable efficient batched tensor operations
process_images_for_pan_and_scan: process a list of torch tensors through pan-and-scan cropping and return cropped patches with crop counts
